title: What Questions Can Nova Help Answer?
excerpt: Nova is best suited to questions that can be answered from Alle's ClinX product, safety, technical, policy and compliance information, with role-aware explanations and source references.
seo_title: What Questions Can Nova Help Answer? | Alle's ClinX
meta_description: See the types of product, safety, technical, compliance, document and dilution questions Nova can help answer and when a human check is still needed.
content_html:
Nova is most useful when the question relates to Alle's ClinX products, documents, policies or operational guidance. It can turn technical source material into a shorter answer suited to the role of the person asking.

Product-use questions

Users can ask what a product is intended for, which surfaces or tasks it supports, what working ratio is documented, or what use restrictions appear in the official product information.

Safety and handling questions

Nova can help locate documented PPE, storage, first-aid, incompatibility or handling information from available safety documents. Safety-critical answers should still be checked against the current SDS.

Document lookup questions

Users can ask where information appears in an SDS, TDS, certification, policy or other Alle's ClinX document and, where available, follow Nova's citation back to the original source.

Compliance and policy questions

Nova can summarize documented certifications, policy requirements or official company information when those materials exist in its knowledge base.

Supported quantitative questions

Where the source documentation contains the required values, Nova can support calculations such as dilution quantities using code-based computation instead of an estimate.

The same question can be answered differently by role

A frontline user may receive a short safety-first explanation, while a supervisor or procurement user may receive more document, compliance or business context.

Questions outside the documentation may have limited support

If Alle's ClinX documentation does not contain the needed evidence, Nova may not be able to provide a confident document-grounded answer. The current interface also offers a separate web-search tool when live internet information is appropriate.

Practical takeaway

Ask Nova questions that you would otherwise answer by searching product pages, SDS/TDS files, company policies or compliance documents. For critical decisions, confirm the cited source directly.
